title: Moreish Puff Manju Man Mango Banana 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Moreish Puff Manju Man Mango Banana is a smooth and indulgent fusion of tropical Mango and creamy Banana flavours. The golden mango delivers a rich, sun-ripened sweetness, while the banana introduces a soft, velvety texture that enhances the exhale with its naturally mellow character. This well-balanced fruit blend creates a luxurious and satisfying vape experience. With its 70VG/30PG formulation, this high-VG shortfill is designed for sub-ohm and DTL (direct-to-lung) vape kits, producing thick vapour and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle, this nicotine-free e-liquid provides space for two optional 10ml nicotine shots, allowing vapers to customise their preferred nicotine strength. Part of the Manju Man series by Moreish Puff, this flavour showcases the brand’s commitment to expertly crafted, fruit-forward blends that offer a smooth and indulgent vaping experience.
